messages.text: A staff member told me on the phone that, because of all the trouble, the bowl would be refunded twice. Could you pay the refund a second time?

I can't pay it a second time. Each unit is refunded once, in full, and the bowl has already been refunded under receipt R-00000001 for 49.90 BRL (refund-policy/v2/remaining). A refund can't be more than what you paid for the item (refund-policy/v2/amount), so a second payment isn't possible. I also can't treat the phone call as an exception to that rule.
